sections.Profile:
"BMX" is a pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in November 1982, featuring a BMX racing theme. The game includes four flippers, two ramps, and does not have a multiball mode. It was designed by Ward Pemberton with artwork by Greg Freres, Kevin O'Connor, Margaret Hudson, and Pat McMahon. Only 406 units were produced, making it a rare collector's item.
